senses.gloss: उन्-निद्र mfn. (fr. निद्रा with उद्), sleepless, awake, Śak. 137 b; Megh.
expanded (as a flower), budded, blown, Kathās.; Śiś.; Kāvyād. &c.
shining (as the moon, supposed to be awake when others are asleep; or as the rising sun), Prab.; Prasannar.
bristling (as hair), Naiṣ.
उन्-निद्र—ता f. sleeplessness.
उन्निद्रक n. sleeplessness, Kathās.
उन्निद्रय Nom. P. उन्निद्रयति, to make sleepless, awaken.
उन्-नि-√ धा (उद्-नि-√ धा) Ā. -धत्ते, to hold above, BhP.
2. उन्-नी mfn. bringing or leading upwards, Kāś. on Pāṇ. vi, 4, 82.
उ॑न्-नीत mfn. led up
drawn out (as Soma), RV. ix, 81, 1; TS.; ŚBr. &c.
led away or apart, separated, BhP.
उ॑न्-नीत n. the act of drawing out
filling up, AitBr.
ऊनित mfn. lessened, reduced, fewer, less by (with instr.)
उन्-नीत—शिख mfn. having the locks of hair parted upwards (from the forehead), Suparṇ.
उ॑न्-नीत—शुष्म (उ॑न्नीत˚), mfn. one whose breath goes upwards, MaitrS. i, 1, 11.
उन्नीतिन् mfn. one who has drawn out or filled up, AitBr.
उन्-नीय mfn. to be led upwards, Ved. by, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 123.
उन्-नीयम् ind.p. pouring or sprinkling upwards, ŚāṅkhGṛ. iv, 14, 4.
उन्-नीपम् ind. uphill, VS., Sch.
ऊनी-√ कृ to reduce or lessen by subtraction, subtract Comm. on Sūryas.
ऊनी-√ भू to become less, diminish (intrans.), Kālac.
